answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. A new agent locks a 40 POA bond and files its fingerprint — rhythm, counterparties — in a harbor registry. Each epoch a comet pass, a probe, asks it to repeat a fragment; match unlocks 2 POA, mismatch freezes the bond. At the zenith of activity it is re-checked, so clones diverge. Faking 100 locks 4,000 POA plus 5 each/epoch; one honest agent pays 40 once and earns it back, rewards never diluted.
